title: French Croquettes
description: A delicious and easy-to-make snack using French croquettes. Perfect for a quick bite.
instructions: Place the French croquettes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
While the croquettes are baking, melt the gooey cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
If desired, mix in the ultra creamy sauce to create a cheesy dip.
Serve the warm French croquettes with the gooey cheese dip.
